intersections.note: both continue off the sheet: Liddell north onto 519, Dempsey west onto 513
Dempsey turns east-south-east at x about 4125 and ends at Cummings (45 ft), which runs on north off the top edge beside the railroad

offset crossing: VINTON ST. comes in diagonally from the west (sheet 513) and reaches Liddell's west line centred at y about 3528; VINTON leaves Liddell's east line square to it, centred at y about 3784. Point is the centre of the four block corners
Vinton ends at Cummings; Cummings's east side is the first railroad track, so the centre is taken about 23 ft out from the block line

merge, not a square crossing: Cummings runs along the railroad and joins Western at the point of block 4 (x 3400, y 6325). Western bends here to Cummings's direction and the combined street runs on to Fairmount. Point is Western's bend on its centreline (the water pipe bends here too)

Liddell ends at Fairmount. Fairmount is 24 ft west of Liddell and 50 ft east of it; its south-west side is one straight line, and only the north-east side steps out at Liddell. Same crossing as on sheet 512

at the bottom edge: Fairmount's south-west line is off the paper here; centre taken 25 ft out from the north-east line, and on Western's centreline (water pipe). Western continues south onto sheet 512, where it is labelled Beekman; same crossing as Beekman Street / Fairmount Avenue on 512

widths.note: 45 ft printed at Dempsey, 40 ft near the merge with Western
50 ft east of Liddell; 24 ft printed west of Liddell

bends.note: turns from square to Western onto an east-south-east course to Cummings
diagonal west arm (VINTON ST.) meets Liddell's west line here
east arm leaves Liddell's east line here, square to Liddell

notes: Single panel, but the sheet is drawn rotated: north arrow points to the upper right (about 35 degrees), so Liddell and Western Av. run up the page and Fairmount Av. runs diagonally across the bottom. Dempsey (50 ft) along the top, Vinton (50 ft) across the middle, Fairmount Av. at the bottom left. Cummings (45 ft, 40 ft at its south end) runs along the C.H.&D. railroad from the top-right corner down to Western, which it joins at the point of block 4. Western Av. (60 ft) runs straight from the top edge to y about 6890, then bends to Cummings's direction and reaches Fairmount at the bottom edge; south of Fairmount, on sheet 512, the same street is labelled BEEKMAN. The strip west of Liddell is part of sheet 513 (block 6, the diagonal stub of VINTON ST.); the dash-dot line marked A and B there is a boundary line, not a street. No alleys. Vacant ground and dairy buildings east of the railroad, no streets.
